title: No more Valhelsia Structures
description: Sick of Valhelsia's overpowered structures? Discover gorgeous furniture sets made exclusively for this mod, with none of the balance-breaking issues!
body:
Sick of Valhelsia's overpowered structures? Discover gorgeous furniture sets made exclusively for this mod, with none of the balance-breaking structures! Sleeping bags, glazed jars, metal-framed glass and panes, wooden posts and braizers!
